# autoyield

> MCP server for researching tokenized US stocks (Backed xStocks such as SPYx, NVDAx, TSLAx) and USDC yield on Solana. Read-only research edition needs no sign-in; a full edition also prepares unsigned transactions that the user signs in their own wallet (non-custodial). Not investment advice; tokenized US stocks are not offered to US persons.

## Connect

- Research edition (read-only, no sign-in, listed in the Claude connector directory): https://mcp.autoyield.org/research
- Full edition (adds prepare-to-sign buy/sell/deposit/withdraw; OAuth with a free Phantom signature): https://autoyield-api.fly.dev/mcp
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http autoyield https://mcp.autoyield.org/research`
- Local stdio package: `npx -y @kaditang/agent-wallet-mcp` (npm: @kaditang/agent-wallet-mcp; MCP Registry: io.github.kaditang/agent-wallet-mcp)

## Tools (research edition)

- compare_yields: rank USDC lending and tokenized-treasury yields across chains by risk-adjusted APY, with risk scores and reasons
- quote_tokenized_stock: live Jupiter quote, order-size cost vs a $100 buy, and an entry-timing signal (premium vs the real NYSE price against its own history)
- check_xstock_safety: verify a tokenized stock is the issuer's genuine token; flags copycats, depegs, thin liquidity, trading halts
- get_portfolio, portfolio_health, suggest_rebalance, export_history: wallet holdings, checkups, rebalance suggestions, trade-history CSV for any public Solana address
- list_xstocks, list_yield_tokens, track_tx
